cctv.lead: Surveillance systems planned around your premises, then installed and configured to a professional standard for homes, offices, hotels, schools, hospitals, factories, estates and institutions.
cctv.note: Often combined with access control, intercom and electric fence systems.

solar.lead: Solar and backup power systems designed around your requirements. We approach solar as a system, not a product sale.
solar.note: System capacity and performance depend on your load requirements and the equipment specified.

maintenance.lead: Installation is not the end of the relationship. DESS supports existing systems so they keep performing, which matters most for commercial and institutional sites.
maintenance.note: Covers solar, CCTV, connectivity and other relevant installed technology.

consultation.lead: Work out the right technical solution before you purchase equipment or begin installation. We act as a technical partner, not only an installer.
consultation.note: Phone consultations are free. Site consultations are paid, and the price depends on the location. Consultation can lead into design, supply, installation and ongoing support.
